# The English Lounge

> Affordable private English lessons in Rome, Italy, and online, with Jasper, a native Canadian English teacher. Tagline: "Learn English in Comfort". Free 20-minute trial lesson.

The English Lounge offers private English lessons for professionals, students preparing for exams and anyone who wants to feel more confident in English. Lessons take place in person in Rome or online by video call, from beginner to advanced.

## Teacher

- Name: Jasper, native Canadian English speaker
- 12+ years of teaching experience
- M.A. in Linguistics (University of Siena), TTC/TEFL certified
- Speaks English and Italian

## Lessons

- General English: everyday conversation, grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation
- Business English: presentations, meetings, negotiations and email writing
- Exam preparation: IELTS and Cambridge, with strategies, mock exams and personalised study plans
- Companies, groups and semi-private lessons: team training and tailored corporate programmes
- Format: one-on-one or small groups, in person in Rome or online
- Price: affordable rates, depending on the type of lesson and on single lessons or a package. Ask during the free trial for current rates.
- Free 20-minute trial lesson with no payment and no commitment
